studio.seoTitle: Generate Short Videos Online Free with AI — FreeShortVideo Studio
studio.seoDescription: FreeShortVideo Studio: generate short videos online free with AI. Enter an idea, AI splits it into 2-5 scenes, generates text-to-video clips, and concatenates them in your browser. No install, no GPU, no credit card — free Agnes API Key required.
studio.seoH1: Generate Short Videos Online Free with AI — FreeShortVideo Studio
studio.seoIntro: FreeShortVideo Studio is a web-based AI short video generator: enter an idea, AI automatically splits it into 2-5 scenes, generates a 5-second video per scene, and concatenates them into a complete short video locally in your browser. Completely free, online, no install, no high-end GPU, no credit card — just add your free Agnes API Key.

apiKey.localOnly: Your key is stored only in your browser's localStorage. It is never uploaded to any server. You'll need to re-enter it after clearing browser data.

studio.ideaPlaceholder: Describe your video theme, e.g.: A healing story of a stray kitten finding a warm home in the city
studio.ideaHint: More specific story ideas produce more coherent scenes. Include theme, mood, and key plot points.
studio.timeHint: Scene splitting takes about 10-20 seconds, video generation about 3-5 minutes per segment.
studio.generatingHint: Generating videos segment by segment, please wait. Each segment takes about 3-5 minutes.
studio.ffmpegLoadingHint: First use requires downloading the ffmpeg.wasm engine (~30MB), cached afterwards.
studio.concatenatingHint: Unifying resolution and concatenating all segments into the final video.
studio.completedNote: This video is entirely generated and concatenated in your browser. The first version does not include AI voiceover and subtitles, which will be added gradually.
